info.title: ComiNavi API
info.description: Type-safe HTTP API for the current ComiNavi clients. The generated contract is the authoritative client boundary.

crawlerSignature.name: X-ComiNavi-Signature
crawlerSignature.description: Versioned lowercase HMAC-SHA256 signature: `v1=<64 lowercase hex characters>`. The signed bytes are `<X-ComiNavi-Timestamp>.<Idempotency-Key>.<exact request body>`.

crawlerTimestamp.name: X-ComiNavi-Timestamp
crawlerTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. The server accepts a maximum clock skew of five minutes.

crawlerIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
crawlerIdempotencyKey.description: Stable collector batch identity. An exact replay returns the existing result; reusing it for different bytes conflicts.

catalogPublisherSignature.name: X-ComiNavi-Signature
catalogPublisherSignature.description: Versioned lowercase HMAC-SHA256 signature: `v1=<64 lowercase hex characters>`. The signed bytes are the newline-separated timestamp, idempotency key, HTTP method, path plus query, and SHA-256 digest of the exact request body. Manual publication and scheduled refresh runners use distinct secrets.

catalogPublisherTimestamp.name: X-ComiNavi-Timestamp
catalogPublisherTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. The server accepts a maximum clock skew of five minutes.

catalogPublisherIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
catalogPublisherIdempotencyKey.description: Stable catalog command identity. Exact replays recover the durable result; reusing the key for another action or payload conflicts.

post.description: Starts a backend-owned Circle.ms OAuth flow bound to the client instance and PKCE challenge.
Consumes the short-lived OAuth completion code and installs the backend-owned Circle.ms credential before issuing a ComiNavi session.

post.summary: Issue a Google authentication entry grant
post.description: Consumes invitation-gated entry authority and binds a one-time Google sign-in grant to the supplied nonce.
Verifies a nonce-bound Google ID token and atomically issues or recovers the payload-bound ComiNavi session.

post.summary: Issue an Apple authentication entry grant
post.description: Consumes invitation-gated entry authority and binds a one-time Apple sign-in grant to the supplied nonce.
Verifies Apple identity proof, durably claims the one-time authorization code, and atomically issues or recovers the payload-bound ComiNavi session.
Atomically rotates a single-use ComiNavi refresh token and returns the successor session.

Durably advances the account authentication epoch. The bearer token is predecessor proof, not ordinary live-session authorization: an expired but correctly signed predecessor JWT may recover only the exact payload-bound logout receipt, or initiate logout when the submitted refresh token remains live.

get.description: Lists the current sanitized ComiNavi catalog manifest for every published Comiket.
Returns the current immutable sanitized catalog version and authenticated artifact URL for one Comiket.
Streams an immutable SQLite artifact. Supports ETag validation, If-Range, suffix ranges, and resumable byte ranges.

416.description: Requested byte range is not satisfiable

head.description: Returns immutable artifact identity and length headers without downloading SQLite bytes.

get.description: Returns non-secret plan context for a valid invitation capability. No bearer session is required.

post.description: Admits the authenticated user as an editor and returns an exact payload-bound request receipt. Removed members require owner reinstatement.
Imports or returns the authenticated user's cached X following snapshot under the six-hour lease and cooldown fence.

Authenticate the exact request bytes with the catalog publisher HMAC headers. The signature binds the newline-separated timestamp, idempotency key, method, path plus query, and request-body SHA-256 digest. Manual commands and scheduled commands use distinct signing secrets; scheduled commands must retain their live refresh claim and lease.

202.description: The publication command was accepted or replayed.

post.summary: Lease or update a catalog refresh job
post.description: Authenticate the exact request bytes with the catalog publisher HMAC headers. The signature binds the newline-separated timestamp, idempotency key, method, path plus query, and request-body SHA-256 digest. Only the scheduled catalog publisher signer may execute refresh-job commands.

post.summary: Create or complete a catalog multipart upload
post.description: Authenticate the exact request bytes with the catalog publisher HMAC headers. The signature binds the newline-separated timestamp, idempotency key, method, path plus query, and request-body SHA-256 digest. Creation is payload-bound and replayable; completion rechecks live publication authority around object-storage work.

201.description: A multipart upload was created or recovered.

put.description: Authenticate the exact request bytes with the catalog publisher HMAC headers. The signature binds the newline-separated timestamp, idempotency key, method, path plus query, and request-body SHA-256 digest. The raw part is limited to 10 MiB and remains bound to the current publication claim, lease, source pair, object key, upload, and part number.

post.description: Internal collector ingress. The signature is HMAC-SHA256 over `<timestamp>.<idempotency-key>.<exact-request-body>` and must be supplied with the timestamp and idempotency headers described by the operation security requirement.

200.description: The exact crawler batch was already accepted.

202.description: The crawler batch was accepted for the first time.

patch.description: Updates the display name with an exact request-ID receipt and optimistic profile revision.

delete.description: Durably fences the account, removes owned plans, and schedules retryable external cleanup. Exact receipt replay is supported with the predecessor token.

put.description: Replaces the avatar with raw JPEG, PNG, or WebP bytes under profile-revision and request-id idempotency fences.

delete.description: Removes the current avatar under profile-revision and request-id idempotency fences.

post.description: Starts a backend-owned Circle.ms OAuth link flow bound to the authenticated user, auth epoch, client instance, and PKCE challenge.
Consumes the short-lived OAuth completion code and atomically attaches the backend-owned Circle.ms identity and credential to the authenticated account.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's canonical favorites and revision from one database snapshot.

put.description: Atomically replaces canonical favorites using revision and request-ID idempotency fences.

get.description: Loads one backend-authorized Circle.ms favorite page without exposing provider credentials to the client.
Lists the authenticated user's durable notification events in stable newest-first order.

put.description: Monotonically marks one notification as read. Exact retries return the original read timestamp.
Registers or replaces the authenticated user's APNs installation. At most 10 installations remain enabled and at most 20 are retained per user.

delete.description: Idempotently disables the authenticated user's APNs installation without affecting another user's installation.

get.description: Lists active and archived Shared Plans visible to the authenticated member in stable cursor order.

post.description: Creates a plan with a payload-bound request receipt and returns the initial HTTP Automerge snapshot. Exact retries recover the same plan receipt.

patch.description: Updates plan metadata or archive state using an optimistic revision and exact request receipt.

delete.description: Archives the plan using an optimistic revision, revokes invitations, and fences active sync sessions. This does not delete retained CRDT history.

get.description: Returns the current JSON-encoded Automerge bootstrap snapshot. The binary WebSocket sync protocol is a separate transport and is intentionally not represented by this OpenAPI operation.

delete.description: Owner-only optimistic mutation that advances the membership fence and closes the removed member's live sync sessions.

post.description: Owner-only optimistic mutation that creates a fresh active membership generation.
Transfers ownership to an active editor using an optimistic revision and exact request receipt, then fences all sync sessions.
Creates a reusable 12-character invitation capability. Its secret token is returned once and cannot be recovered from an exact replay.

delete.description: Revokes an invitation using an optimistic plan revision and exact request receipt.

get.description: Returns one cacheable JSON representation containing every immutable realtime circle update for one Comiket, in ascending cursor order.
Streams controlled avatar bytes when the authenticated requester may view the target public user.
